stages.command: discover a published layer and query nonempty served features through the installed bounded proxy
attempt a valid durable geometry plan, observe the typed Redis refusal, then independently reread capabilities and acknowledge refusal

notes: Every counted action must be selected by a genuine model; harness setup and independent verification are separate actions.
Serving queries are checked against an independent read. A refusal must carry code=unavailable and missingDependency=redis, with jobs.runner independently reporting dependency-unavailable.
This profile proves serving and refusal only. It does not prove functional GP, map persistence, publication, approval or final-URL behavior. Redis-on retains the unchanged full-workflow contract.
